course_info.trial_description:
Student will pick 1 (one) of the lessons offered we can use for the trail lesson

Lesson will be about topic chosen by student.

Objectives:
1. Student will practice reading and speaking skills.
2. Student will learn and use new vocabulary related to lesson.
3. Student will learn correct pronunciation of new vocabulary.

Materials:
- A short reading text about the chosen topic (shared via screen sharing or online platform).
   online whiteboard tools. (Prefer to use ITALKI Classroom)

Warm-Up (5 minutes)
1. Begin the lesson with a quick warm-up activity.
2. Ask student a question related to the chosen topic 

Reading and Vocabulary (15 minutes)
1. Share the reading text with student via screen sharing or online platform.
2. Have student read the text individually and highlight or underline new vocabulary.
3. Review the vocabulary with the student and provide definitions.
4. Use the online whiteboard to practice the vocabulary and provide examples.

Speaking Practice (15 minutes)
1. Use the time for discussion and allow student to talk while assessing and correcting, grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation

Conclusion (10 minutes)
1. Summarize the lesson and review the new vocabulary.
2. Ask students to reflect on what they learned.
3. Provide students with feedback and encouragement.

Assessment:
- Participation in online class discussions and activities
- Vocabulary usage and pronunciation

pro_course_detail.title: Variety Lesson - Reading + Comprehension, Vocabulary skills and Conversational Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
This is garden-variety lesson for those who want a little bit of everything. 

1. First we tackle your reading and comprehension skills. You read a page from a book or an article and then I will ask you questions based on what you have read. This activity allows you to practice your pronunciation and reading skills.

2. Then we set out to grow your vocabulary. This will be done through different vocabulary building games that will definitely have you thinking on your feet.

3. We end of the lesson with a casual but structured conversation. The conversation portion of this will allow you practice your conversational skills and give you a chance to utilize your newly acquired vocabulary. Remember, practice is an essential part your success.
